name: Quantum simulation of molecular dynamics benchmark (classical and present-day quantum hardware)
description: Evaluates and compares molecular dynamics simulation workflows across classical simulators and current quantum hardware on a set of molecular problems.
evaluation_method: simulation accuracy (energy error / RMSE, fidelity) combined with resource metrics (runtime, gate count, qubit usage) and success rate on hardware
general_score_metric: energy error / fidelity (primary) plus resource-usage metrics (runtime, gate depth, qubit count)
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark referenced in quantum chemistry/quantum computing literature for comparing classical and near-term quantum simulation workflows; recognized within the quantum simulation research community but not a broadly used ML benchmark.
notes: Designed for classical simulators and present-day noisy quantum hardware — results are strongly affected by hardware noise and limited qubit counts; small-scale / toy molecular systems are typical; not an LLM benchmark and reproducibility may require access to specific quantum devices or high-performance classical simulators.
